description: Fixed-embedding candidate selection; preregistered before training
checkpoint_selection: Highest official validation correct count, then lowest validation BCE, then earliest epoch
learning_rate_selection: At seed 17: highest official validation correct count, then lowest validation BCE; exact ties prefer first listed learning rate
final_seed_policy: Seed 17 checkpoint of model with highest five-seed mean validation accuracy; exact ties prefer lower parameter count. No ensemble.
question_features: Top 1024 train-only document-frequency word unigrams/bigrams, minimum df 2; log TF-IDF and L2 normalization
input_normalization: Per-dimension mean/std fitted on all training candidates only; std floor 1e-4
test_policy: No test predictions, metrics or model selection; official checker may read test only for integrity/alignment
